{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check the unique values in the 'arm' column
unique_arms = trial_df['arm'].unique()
print("Unique arms:", unique_arms)

# Check the unique values in the 'response' column
unique_responses = trial_df['response'].unique()
print("Unique responses:", unique_responses)

# Check the distribution of arms
arm_counts = trial_df['arm'].value_counts()
print("Arm counts:\n", arm_counts)

# Check the distribution of responses in the TREATMENT arm
response_in_treatment = trial_df[trial_df['arm'] == 'TREATMENT']['response'].value_counts()
print("Response distribution in TREATMENT arm:\n", response_in_treatment)

# Compute the fraction of responders in the TREATMENT arm
num_responders = trial_df[(trial_df['arm'] == 'TREATMENT') & (trial_df['response'] == 1)].shape[0]
total_treatment = trial_df[trial_df['arm'] == 'TREATMENT'].shape[0]
fraction_responders = num_responders / total_treatment
print(f"Fraction of responders in TREATMENT arm: {fraction_responders}")"}
